title: Allayment
summary: ALLA'YMENT, noun The act of quieting, or a state of tranquility; a state of rest after disturbance; abatement; ease; as, the allayment of grief.

inlines.v: ALLA'YMENT, noun The act of quieting, or a state of tranquility; a state of rest after disturbance; abatement; ease; as, the allayment of grief.
